giver: A village cartographer with Cave Maps, and the cave tablets left in abandoned cabins
feel: Six strange worlds under the stone, each with its own tech, creatures and climax

quests.title: Rumours from Below
quests.summary: A village cartographer speaks of whole worlds under the stone and sells Cave Maps; buy one and let it search out the nearest cave biome.
quests.reward: Exploration XP, emeralds toward a second map

quests.title: The Abandoned Cabin
quests.summary: Stumbling on an underground cabin deep in the rock, you find a cave tablet among its chests; it points toward a hidden biome.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a cave tablet, torches

quests.title: The Spelunker's Notes
quests.summary: Craft a Cave Book to keep notes on every cave biome, and a Cave Codex as your journal of the underworld.

quests.title: Pull of the Deep
quests.summary: Follow the Cave Map down into the Magnetic Caves, where galena spires float and metal tugs at your belt.

quests.title: Ferrocave
quests.summary: Find a ferrocave, its walls studded with scarlet and azure neodymium nodes.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a pickaxe repair kit

quests.title: Scarlet and Azure
quests.summary: Mine raw scarlet and azure neodymium and smelt ingots of both colours.

quests.title: Opposites Attract
quests.summary: Craft scarlet and azure magnets and use them to pull metal blocks across a gap.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a stack of iron blocks

quests.title: The Magnetron
quests.summary: A Magnetron stalks the cave, pulling metal blocks into a body; bring it down and survive the teletors and notors around it.

quests.title: The Galena Gauntlet
quests.summary: Forge a Galena Gauntlet and use it to fling and catch metal; master the gauntlet challenge.

quests.title: Lightning in a Bulb
quests.summary: Build a working magnetic machine: tesla bulbs, a quarry smasher, or a finished quarry.

quests.title: Lost World
quests.summary: Under the forest roof lies a land of ferns and cycads: the Primordial Caves, home of the dinosaurs.

quests.title: The Dinosaur Bowl
quests.summary: Look down into a dino bowl and watch grottoceratops herds, subterranodons and relicheirus graze among the tar.

quests.title: Primordial Supper
quests.summary: Hunt a grottoceratops for dinosaur chops and cook them into hearty meals.

quests.title: Wings Over the Cave
quests.summary: Tame a subterranodon and ride it across the cavern.

quests.title: The Stolen Egg
quests.summary: Vallumraptors have taken an atlatitan egg; take it back from their pack and carry it safely to hatch.

quests.title: Trapped in Amber
quests.summary: Search the cave walls for amber and an amber curiosity, old relics sealed inside.

quests.title: The Volcano
quests.summary: Find the primordial volcano, a mountain of magma and tephra that the Tremorsaurus guards.

quests.title: The Tremorsaurus
quests.summary: Take down a tremorsaurus and claim a heavy bone from the giant.

quests.title: Ominous Catalyst
quests.summary: Combine heavy bones with an amber curiosity to craft the Ominous Catalyst that can wake something at the volcano.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a spare heavy bone

quests.title: The Luxtructosaurus
quests.summary: Use the Ominous Catalyst at the volcano to summon the Luxtructosaurus (600 health, 20 armour); outlast its meteors and stomps.

quests.title: Extinction
quests.summary: Craft the Extinction Spear from the tectonic shard, the underworld's final weapon.

quests.title: Gear Up
quests.summary: Before entering the Toxic Caves, craft a hazmat suit and mask; radiation kills unprotected explorers.

quests.title: Glow of Uranium
quests.summary: Descend into the Toxic Caves, a land of green acid and glowing uranium.

quests.title: The Acid Pit
quests.summary: Find an acid pit and pull a cache from its edge before radiation takes hold.

quests.title: Raycat
quests.summary: Tame a raycat with raw fish; it purifies radiation around you. Feed gammaroaches too.

quests.title: Raygun
quests.summary: Gather uranium rods and scrap metal and craft a raygun, then test its beam on the gammaroaches.

quests.title: Defuse It
quests.summary: A nucleeper has primed; defuse the nuclear bomb before it blows.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a nuclear furnace component

quests.title: Raising Tremorzilla
quests.summary: Irradiate a tremorsaurus egg into Tremorzilla's egg, hatch it, and raise the monster as your own.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a stack of food

quests.title: Down to the Depths
quests.summary: Craft a diving helmet, suit and boots for the drowned chasm.

quests.title: Into the Abyss
quests.summary: Under the ocean floor, find the Abyssal Chasm, where lanternfish and tripodfish swim in the dark.

quests.title: The Submarine
quests.summary: Build a submarine and pilot it to the trench's floor.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a stack of copper

quests.title: Ruins of the Deep Ones
quests.summary: Sneak into abyssal ruins, the city of the deep ones, without stirring the mine guardians.

quests.title: Trade with the Deep
quests.summary: Earn the deep ones' trust with offerings at an abyssal altar and trade for their gear: a sea staff or an ortholance.

quests.title: Deep Sea Sushi
quests.summary: Catch lanternfish, tripodfish and mussels and roll them into deep sea sushi.

quests.title: The Hullbreaker
quests.summary: The Hullbreaker, a giant bony angler that rams submarines, hunts the trench's floor; bring it down from your sub or on foot.

quests.title: Where Light Dies
quests.summary: Descend into the Forlorn Hollows, a moonless world of watchers, gloomoths and corrodents.

quests.title: The Forlorn Canyon
quests.summary: Find the forlorn canyon and its guano-stained cliffs.

quests.title: Cross the Bridge
quests.summary: Cross a forlorn bridge over the void while underzealots hunt in the dark.

quests.title: The Watcher
quests.summary: Watchers take your eyes; kill one before it can switch your view.

quests.title: The Forsaken
quests.summary: Underzealots perform a ritual to summon the Forsaken, a towering blind beast; fight it as it emerges.
quests.reward: Attack XP, golden apples, night vision potions

quests.title: The Dreadbow
quests.summary: Craft a dreadbow and a desolate dagger from pure darkness and dark tatters.

quests.title: The Beholder
quests.summary: Build a beholder and use it to watch far places.

quests.title: Sugar Rush
quests.summary: A cave full of sweets: the Candy Cavity, with its frosting hills and soda lakes.

quests.title: Gingerbread Town
quests.summary: Visit a gingerbread town and its gingerbread men.

quests.title: The Licowitch Tower
quests.summary: Climb a licowitch tower and defeat the licowitch at its top.

quests.title: A Tour of Sweets
quests.summary: Visit a cake cave, a soda bottle and a donut arch, collecting a treat from each.

quests.title: The Confection Oven
quests.summary: Craft a confection oven and bake sweets in it.

quests.title: Gummy Friends
quests.summary: Feed a gummy bear and ride a candicorn.

quests.title: The Gum Worm
quests.summary: Hook a gum worm with a candy cane hook and ride it.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a candy cane hook

quests.title: Six Worlds Below
quests.summary: Visit all six cave biomes and record them in your Cave Codex.

quests.title: The Conversion Crucible
quests.summary: Use a conversion crucible to turn an area into a cave biome.
